scope: P2-only immutable experiment verifier, local adversarial tests, and bounded live Nemotron review. Published on p2 for pull-request review; no P1 workflow integration or deployment.

integrations.purpose: Independently review experiment plans and evidence, returning validated pass/repair/blocked decisions and stable targeted repairs.

checks.expected: Adversarial contract tests reject missing scenarios, mismatched audiences/context, stale hashes, failed deterministic checks, malformed reviews, invalid evidence/repairs, transport failure, and exhausted budgets.
checks.observed: 20 verifier tests passed; standalone CLI rejects missing-scenario and audience-mismatch fixtures with zero model calls; explicit fixture pass remains mock.

checks.expected: The actual Rust verifier calls the selected Nemotron model through Crusoe and returns a fully validated review for a labeled synthetic fixture; no silent fixture fallback.
checks.observed: Actual Rust direct Crusoe/Nemotron review passed the complete final fixture; one live call, all required findings pass, no repairs or errors.

checks.expected: The live verifier rejects a deliberately unsupported real-world conclusion and supplies a valid targeted repair.
checks.observed: Actual live Nemotron review blocked an unsupported causal/predictive claim and returned two validated targeted repairs; no transport or response-validation error.

checks.expected: Backend regression checks and required build checks complete, with unrelated environmental failures reported accurately.
checks.observed: Final workspace tests: 210 passed, zero failed; release validate and P2 example builds passed. Strict Clippy is blocked by pre-existing backend lint issues; P2 has no warnings with that baseline deny lint allowed.

integrations.purpose: Run the verifier request inside an existing sandbox through its managed Crusoe inference route, without loading an API credential into the verifier process.

checks.expected: The actual Rust sandbox transport executes the fixed Python bridge inside the Ready simtra sandbox; Nemotron returns a validated rejection of an unsupported conclusion, with no Crusoe key in the Rust process environment.
checks.observed: Actual Rust fixed bridge executed inside simtra through managed Crusoe/Nemotron inference; API-key environment absent; expected blocked verdict and two repairs.
